module.purpose: Provides reactive and snapshot query operations over a typed record store, including filtered history, property indexes, matching record collections, and efficient incremental updates.
module.summary: This module defines the store query layer and its index representations. It builds cached reactive computations over record atoms and change history, supports nested property indexing, maintains ID sets incrementally across additions, updates, and removals, and falls back to full recomputation when history is reset or query criteria change. It also exposes one-time execution and record lookup helpers.
module.businessContext: Supports reactive application data access over typed records. If it fails, indexes, subscriptions, filtered collections, and point-in-time queries can become stale or return incorrect records.

units.name: StoreQueries

detail.name: StoreQueries
detail.summary: StoreQueries provides typed, reactive and snapshot-based queries over records held in an AtomMap. It maintains cached reactive indexes and filtered history computations for efficient record lookup and change tracking.

detail.name: getAllIdsForType
detail.signature: public getAllIdsForType<TypeName extends R['typeName']>(typeName: TypeName): Set<IdOf<Extract<R, { typeName: TypeName }>>>
preconditions: typeName must be a value assignable to R['typeName'].
postconditions: Returns a Set containing the IDs of every record in recordMap whose typeName equals typeName.
Each matching ID appears at most once in the returned Set.
Records whose typeName does not equal typeName are excluded.
invariants: The method does not mutate recordMap or the records it contains.
The returned collection is a Set.
edgeCases: If recordMap is empty, returns an empty Set.
If no record has the requested typeName, returns an empty Set.
If multiple matching records have the same ID, the returned Set contains that ID only once.
Records with other typeName values are ignored.
detail.summary: Returns the unique identifiers of all records whose typeName matches the supplied type name. The result is a Set containing no identifiers for which no matching records exist.

specTests.when: getAllIdsForType('A') is called.
specTests.then: The returned Set contains exactly the IDs of the two A records and excludes the B record's ID.

specTests.when: getAllIdsForType is called with that typeName.
specTests.then: The returned value is an empty Set.

detail.signature: filterHistory(typeName: TypeName): Computed<number, RecordsDiff<Extract<R, { typeName: TypeName }>>>
preconditions: typeName is a valid TypeName value.
postconditions: Returns a Computed instance for the requested type name.
Repeated calls with the same typeName return the cached computed instance.
The computed value contains only the history records and diffs associated with typeName.
invariants: At most one computed filter is created and cached per typeName.
A reset diff causes the computed value to be replaced with the complete current history.
A diff with no changes for typeName preserves the previously computed value.

detail.name: __uncached_createIndex
detail.signature: __uncached_createIndex<TypeName extends R['typeName']>(typeName: TypeName, path: string): RSIndex<Extract<R, { typeName: TypeName }>>
preconditions: typeName must be a valid value of R['typeName'].
postconditions: Returns an RSIndex whose computed value maps each defined indexed property value to a set of matching record IDs.
Records with a different typeName are excluded.
Records whose indexed value is undefined are excluded.
The returned index reflects current records on first computation and subsequent relevant additions, updates, and removals.
invariants: Each indexed record ID appears in the set associated with its current defined property value.
A property value with no associated record IDs is absent from the index.
Only changes relevant to the requested typeName and indexed path affect the index.
Nested property access is used when the path contains a backslash; otherwise the path is read as a direct property key.
edgeCases: An initially uninitialized index is built from all current records of the requested type.
A path containing a backslash resolves nested properties; a path without a backslash resolves one direct property.
Records with an undefined indexed value are not inserted into the index.
An updated record whose indexed value changes is removed from the old value set and added to the new value set.
An update that leaves the indexed value unchanged does not alter the index.
When history is reset, the index is rebuilt from the current record map.
When an indexed value loses its final record ID, that value is removed from the index.
detail.summary: Creates a reactive index for records of the requested type, keyed by the value at the specified property path and mapping each key to matching record IDs. The index is initialized from current records and incrementally updated from record history.

specLiterals.role: Prefix for the computed index identity.
Separator used between the type name and property path in the computed index identity.
Path separator indicating nested property access.

specTests.when: That record is updated so its indexed value changes to a different defined value.
specTests.then: The record ID is removed from the old value's set and added to the new value's set.

specTests.when: The index is recomputed.
specTests.then: The index is rebuilt from the current record map rather than applying an incremental diff.

postconditions: The computed value contains one array element for each current ID, in the same order.

An added or updated record contributes its ID only when it matches the current query.
